title: Magickal Movie Night! Nightmare Before Christmas!
seo_title: Magickal Movie Night: Nightmare Before Christmas in Joplin
description: This is a cozy, spooky movie night where you watch The Nightmare Before Christmas with popcorn, snacks, and drinks, and spend time with the community. Tarot readings are available on request, and there will be a best Nightmare Before Christmas merch contest and a 50/50 raffle; all ages are welcome, and RSVP is recommended because the space holds only 30 people. It takes place November 28, 2026, Time TBD, at 502 S Brownell Ave in Joplin, MO.
